Hits an additional time for each time you lost HP this combat.

CARD.TESLA_COIL.name: Tesla Coil
CARD.TESLA_COIL.text:
Deal 3 damage.
Trigger all Lightning against the enemy.

CARD.THE_BOMB.name: The Bomb
CARD.THE_BOMB.text: At the end of 3 turns, deal 40 damage to ALL enemies.

CARD.THE_GAMBIT.name: The Gambit
CARD.THE_GAMBIT.text:
Gain 50 Block.
If you take unblocked attack damage this combat, die.

CARD.THE_HUNT.name: The Hunt
CARD.THE_HUNT.text:
Deal 10 damage.
If Fatal, gain an additional card reward.

CARD.THE_SCYTHE.name: The Scythe
CARD.THE_SCYTHE.text:
Deal 13 damage.
Permanently increase this card's damage by 4.

CARD.THE_SEALED_THRONE.name: The Sealed Throne
CARD.THE_SEALED_THRONE.text: Whenever you play a card, gain [star:1].

CARD.THINKING_AHEAD.name: Thinking Ahead
CARD.THINKING_AHEAD.text:
Draw 2 cards.
Put 1 card from your Hand on top of your Draw Pile.

CARD.THRASH.name: Thrash
CARD.THRASH.text:
Deal 4 damage twice.
Exhaust a random Attack in your Hand and add its damage to this card.

CARD.THRUMMING_HATCHET.name: Thrumming Hatchet
CARD.THRUMMING_HATCHET.text:
Deal 11 damage.
At the start of your next turn, return this to your Hand.

CARD.THUNDER.name: Thunder
CARD.THUNDER.text: Whenever you Evoke Lightning, deal 6 damage to each enemy hit.

CARD.THUNDERCLAP.name: Thunderclap
CARD.THUNDERCLAP.text: Deal 4 damage and apply 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies.

CARD.TIMES_UP.name: Time's Up
CARD.TIMES_UP.text: Deal damage equal to the enemy's Doom.

CARD.TOOLS_OF_THE_TRADE.name: Tools of the Trade
CARD.TOOLS_OF_THE_TRADE.text: At the start of your turn, draw 1 card and discard 1 card.

CARD.TORIC_TOUGHNESS.name: Toric Toughness
CARD.TORIC_TOUGHNESS.text:
Gain 5 Block.
Gain 5 Block at the start of the next 2 turns.

CARD.TOXIC.name: Toxic
CARD.TOXIC.text: At the end of your turn, if this is in your Hand, take 5 damage.

CARD.TRACKING.name: Tracking
CARD.TRACKING.text: Weak enemies take double damage from Attacks.

CARD.TRANSFIGURE.name: Transfigure
CARD.TRANSFIGURE.text:
Add Replay to a card in your Hand.
It costs an extra [energy:1].

CARD.TRASH_TO_TREASURE.name: Trash to Treasure
CARD.TRASH_TO_TREASURE.text: Whenever you create a Status, Channel 1 random Orb.

CARD.TRUE_GRIT.name: True Grit
CARD.TRUE_GRIT.text:
Gain 7 Block.
Exhaust 1 card at random.

CARD.TYRANNY.name: Tyranny
CARD.TYRANNY.text: At the start of your turn, draw 1 card and Exhaust 1 card from your Hand.

CARD.UNDEATH.name: Undeath
CARD.UNDEATH.text:
Gain 7 Block.
Add a copy of this card into your Discard Pile.

CARD.UNLEASH.name: Unleash
CARD.UNLEASH.text:
Osty deals 6 damage.
Deals additional damage equal to Osty's current HP.

CARD.UNMOVABLE.name: Unmovable
CARD.UNMOVABLE.text: The first time you gain Block from a card each turn, double the amount gained.

CARD.UNRELENTING.name: Unrelenting
CARD.UNRELENTING.text:
Deal 14 damage.
The next Attack you play costs 0 [energy:1].

CARD.UP_MY_SLEEVE.name: Up My Sleeve
CARD.UP_MY_SLEEVE.text:
Add 3 Shivs into your Hand.
Reduce this card's cost by 1.

CARD.UPPERCUT.name: Uppercut
CARD.UPPERCUT.text:
Deal 13 damage.
Apply 1 Weak.
Apply 1 Vulnerable.

CARD.UPROAR.name: Uproar
CARD.UPROAR.text:
Deal 6 damage twice.
Play a random Attack from your Draw Pile.

CARD.VEILPIERCER.name: Veilpiercer
CARD.VEILPIERCER.text:
Deal 10 damage.
The next Ethereal card you play costs 0 [energy:1].

CARD.VICIOUS.name: Vicious
CARD.VICIOUS.text: Whenever you apply Vulnerable, draw 1 card.

CARD.VOID.name: Void
CARD.VOID.text: Whenever you draw this card, lose [energy:1].

CARD.VOID_FORM.name: Void Form
CARD.VOID_FORM.text:
End your turn.
The first 2 cards you play each turn are free to play.

CARD.VOLLEY.name: Volley
CARD.VOLLEY.text: Deal 10 damage to a random enemy X times.

CARD.VOLTAIC.name: Voltaic
CARD.VOLTAIC.text: Channel Lightning equal to the Lightning already Channeled this combat.

CARD.WELL_LAID_PLANS.name: Well-Laid Plans
CARD.WELL_LAID_PLANS.text: At the end of your turn, Retain up to 1 card.

CARD.WHIRLWIND.name: Whirlwind
CARD.WHIRLWIND.text: Deal 5 damage to ALL enemies X times.

CARD.WHITE_NOISE.name: White Noise
CARD.WHITE_NOISE.text: Add a random Power into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

CARD.WISH.name: Wish
CARD.WISH.text: Put a card from your Draw Pile into your Hand.

CARD.WITHER.name: Wither
CARD.WITHER.text: At the end of your turn, if this is in your Hand, take 3 damage.

CARD.WRAITH_FORM.name: Wraith Form
CARD.WRAITH_FORM.text:
Gain 2 Intangible.
At the start of your turn, lose 1 Dexterity.
